newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SRI LANKA CANCELS SEPT DIESEL/JET FUEL BUY TENDER.
newsitem.headline: SRI LANKA CANCELS SEPT DIESEL/JET FUEL BUY TENDER.

text.p: State-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has cancelled its jet fuel and diesel buy tender amid high stocks and brought forward its naphtha sell tender loading dates, a company source said on Tuesday.
The tender, to buy 250,000 barrels of 1.0 percent diesel and 25,000 barrels of jet A-1 for delivery on September 3-4, was scheduled to close August 13.
"The stocks are not moving. We have enough stocks to meet our requirements for the moment," the source said.
He said CPC is likely issue another tender for the diesel and jet to be delivered at a later date in September.
As a result of the cancellation, CPC had brought forward the loading dates for its naphtha sell tender to September 4-5 from September 8-9, the source said.

"It's just a slight adjustment in the daily operations. We had scheduled the jet and gasoil to be delivered during that time, but now since that tender has been postponed, we can use the timing for naphtha" he said.
The naphtha volume remains unchanged at 14,500 tonnes and the tender will still close on August 13 as scheduled.
